stats.notes: No current Common Data Set is posted (EIU's CDS page stops at 2019-20), so this is a baseline: first-time freshman applications/acceptances/enrollments for fall 2025 from EIU Institutional Research's Key Publication Facts (fall 2024 was 12,539 / 8,194 / 779). SAT percentiles and the 3% SAT-submission rate (22 students) are IPEDS fall 2024 via College Navigator; no ACT figures were reported. International applicant/admit counts, GPA and residency splits are not published in these sources. Undergraduate enrollment 4,058 is fall 2025 and excludes 2,673 high-school dual-credit students (College Navigator's fall 2024 figure of 6,785 includes them).

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition shown includes required fees; total cost of attendance is the on-campus out-of-state figure ($28,055 in-state). EIU's international page says international students are budgeted at regular out-of-state rates. Fall 2026 figures are not yet in College Navigator; EIU's own 2026-27 cost calculator is interactive and was not used.
